call_purpose: You wanted your custom domain to load your funnel instead of showing a "site can't be reached" error.

resolved.text: We removed the old records and added the CNAME records for your domain, and you confirmed that both the main address and the www version now load your funnel.

covered.text: We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after connecting the domain.

support_next_steps.text: We will check that the certificate has been issued, and we will message you if it has not.
